title: India Joins 'Pax Silica' Coalition as 10th Full Member
summary: India signs on to Pax Silica coalition at India AI Impact Summit alongside Microsoft's $17.5 billion AI investment.

blocks.content: India joined **'Pax Silica' as its 10th full member** to secure global semiconductor and AI supply chains, coinciding with **Microsoft's $17.5 billion AI infrastructure investment** in India.

provenance.sourceTitle: India Joins 'Pax Silica' Coalition as 10th Full Member
